description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Persistent Constrictor.
When Persistent Constrictor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Persistent Constrictor.
When Persistent Constrictor dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
